purpose.platform.tenant: Stores the main tenant/client information for the platform.
purpose.platform.scope: Stores the tenant hierarchy and links hierarchy nodes to business records owned by other services.
purpose.platform.region_setting: Stores currency, timezone, date, number, and fiscal settings for a regional scope.
purpose.platform.venue_setting: Stores configuration settings that apply to a venue-level scope.
purpose.platform.workstation: Stores POS, Kiosk, and other workstation configuration within a tenant scope.
purpose.platform.device: Stores hardware devices connected to workstations such as scanners, printers, and payment terminals.
purpose.platform.cash_denomination: Stores valid cash note and coin denominations for each supported currency.
purpose.platform.device_profile: Stores versioned configuration settings that can be assigned to a scope or workstation.
purpose.approvals.approval_matrix: Defines a versioned approval policy for a business action within a tenant scope.
purpose.approvals.approval_rule: Defines the conditions, approval level, and approver role required by an approval policy.
purpose.approvals.approval_request: MODIFIED. Stores one approval request for each business action that requires authorization, and now also carries priority, risk level and SLA due time for the Approval Command Center.
purpose.approvals.approval_decision: Stores every approve or reject decision made for an approval request as audit evidence.
purpose.approvals.approval_delegation: Stores temporary approval authority given by one approver to another for a fixed period.
purpose.approvals.approval_escalation: Stores when an approval moves to another approver or higher level and records why it moved.
purpose.platform.cell: Defines each regional TICVAI Cell/deployment and links it to the existing Tenancy scope.
purpose.platform.cell_endpoint: Stores how another Cell/service can securely reach a particular Cell, especially its CrossCell service endpoint.
purpose.platform.subscription_tier: NEW TABLE. Defines TICVAI commercial subscription tiers/packages such as BASIC, PRO, or ENTERPRISE.
purpose.platform.tier_allowance: NEW TABLE. Defines usage/quantity allowances included in a subscription tier.
purpose.platform.tier_module: NEW TABLE. Defines which TICVAI technical modules are commercially included in a subscription tier.
purpose.platform.tenant_subscription: NEW TABLE. Stores the commercial subscription/licensing package currently assigned to a tenant.
purpose.identity.user_account: Stores the security identity of any person, backend service, or device that can authenticate or receive permissions.
purpose.identity.user_login: Stores secure authentication credential information for a principal.
purpose.identity.customer: Stores customer profile information and optionally links a registered customer to a login principal.
purpose.identity.customer_contact: Stores customer email addresses and phone numbers with verification information.
purpose.identity.customer_address: Stores postal, billing, and other addresses belonging to a customer.
purpose.identity.module: Defines the system authorization modules and sub-modules available across the platform. Module definitions are global/system master data and are not duplicated per tenant.
purpose.identity.permission: Defines individual authorization actions under a module or sub-module, such as PRODUCT.VIEW, ORDER.CREATE, or REFUND.APPROVE.
purpose.identity.enabled_module: Defines which platform modules are enabled for a tenant and optionally for a specific scope node such as region, venue, department, or zone.
purpose.identity.role: Defines reusable authorization roles that can be assigned to principals.
purpose.identity.user_access: Assigns a role or direct permission to a principal within a specific scope and validity period.
purpose.identity.refresh_token: Stores hashed refresh tokens and tracks token expiry, rotation, and revocation.
purpose.identity.mfa_method: Stores multi-factor authentication methods configured for a principal.
purpose.identity.otp: Stores temporary email or SMS OTP challenges used for verification and recovery flows.
purpose.identity.password_policy: Stores tenant-level password, lockout, session, and authentication security rules.
purpose.identity.sso_provider: Stores external single-sign-on provider configuration for a tenant.
purpose.identity.sso_group_mapping: Maps groups from an external SSO provider to internal roles and scopes.
purpose.identity.customer_membership: Stores the membership subscription currently owned by a customer.
purpose.identity.membership_history: Stores every status change made to a customer's membership.
purpose.identity.benefit_usage: Tracks each use of a customer's membership benefit and the remaining allowance.
purpose.identity.family: Stores one family or household group so independently registered customers can be linked together.
purpose.identity.family_member: Links each registered customer to a family and records the relationship such as spouse, child or parent.
purpose.identity.customer_extra_field: NEW TABLE. Defines an extra field that Admin wants to add to the customer form, such as Date of Birth, Emergency Contact, or Jersey Size.
purpose.identity.customer_extra_option: NEW TABLE. Stores dropdown choices only when an extra field uses SELECT type, for example Language = English, Hindi, Marathi.
purpose.identity.customer_extra_value: NEW TABLE. Stores the value entered by a customer for each Admin-created extra field.
purpose.catalogue.product_category: Stores categories used to organize products in the catalogue.
purpose.catalogue.product: MODIFIED. Stores the main definition of anything that can be sold or offered.
purpose.catalogue.product_media: Stores images, videos, documents, and other media associated with a product or variant.
purpose.catalogue.product_variant: Stores SKU or option variants of a product.
purpose.catalogue.price_list: Defines a set of prices for a currency, scope, channel, and validity period.
purpose.catalogue.price: Stores the selling price of a product or variant within a price list.
purpose.pricing.dynamic_price_rule: Configurable dynamic pricing component for dynamic price rule.
purpose.pricing.dynamic_price_condition: Configurable dynamic pricing component for dynamic price rule condition.
purpose.pricing.dynamic_price_action: Configurable dynamic pricing component for dynamic price action.
purpose.catalogue.entitlement_template: Defines the access right that should be created when an eligible product is purchased.
purpose.catalogue.event: Stores movies, concerts, shows, and other event definitions that can have scheduled performances.
purpose.catalogue.performance: Stores a scheduled session or performance of an event.
purpose.promotions.bundle: Defines a sellable bundle made from multiple catalogue products or variants.
purpose.promotions.bundle_component: Stores the products or variants and quantities included in a bundle.
purpose.promotions.promotion: Defines discounts or promotional rules applied to eligible catalogue sales.
purpose.promotions.coupon_campaign: Defines a campaign that generates or manages promotional coupon codes.
purpose.promotions.coupon_code: Stores individual coupon codes and tracks their usage status.
purpose.seating.seat_map: Defines the seat layout used for a venue space or performance.
purpose.seating.section: Stores a named section within a seat map such as Balcony, Gold, or Section A.
purpose.seating.seat_section_row: Defines each seating row inside a section.
purpose.seating.seat_category: Defines seat categories such as Standard, Premium, VIP, or Accessible.
purpose.seating.seat: Stores each selectable seat in a seat map.
purpose.seating.seat_rule: Stores seat-selection rules applied to a seat map.
purpose.seating.seat_hold: Temporarily reserves selected seats while a customer completes the purchase.
purpose.seating.seat_hold_item: Stores each individual seat included in a temporary seat hold.
purpose.seating.seat_block: Blocks seats from customer sale for maintenance, operations, VIP allocation, or another business reason.
purpose.seating.seat_block_item: Stores each individual seat included in a seat block.
purpose.catalogue.membership_program: Defines the overall membership programme available to customers.
purpose.catalogue.membership_plan: Defines a sellable membership plan, its duration, renewal rules, and catalogue product.
purpose.catalogue.membership_benefit: Defines a benefit that can be included in one or more membership plans.
purpose.catalogue.plan_benefit: Maps membership benefits to plans and defines usage limits for each benefit.
purpose.catalogue.product_recommendation: Defines product recommendations for ticketing products. One table handles UPSELL, CROSS_SELL and sellable ADD_ON relationships, including targets owned by FnB or Retail.
purpose.catalogue.upgrade_rule: Defines valid post-purchase upgrade paths, for example Standard Ticket to VIP Ticket, and how the upgrade amount should be calculated.
purpose.catalogue.rental_product_config: NEW TABLE. Stores rental-specific configuration for a Catalogue product, including tracking mode and operational controls.
purpose.catalogue.rental_rule: NEW TABLE. Defines reusable product-level rental rules such as duration, grace, overdue charge, cancellation, pickup/return, and deposit policy.
purpose.catalogue.rental_requirement: NEW TABLE. Defines customer requirements that must be satisfied before a rental can be confirmed or checked out.
purpose.catalogue.rental_rate: NEW TABLE. Stores time-based rental prices such as per minute, hour, day, or fixed duration block.
purpose.fnb.product_category: Groups F&B products into categories such as Food, Beverage, Combo, Dessert or Add-on.
purpose.fnb.product: Stores the independent master record for each sellable F&B item. This table does not depend on Ticketing Catalogue.
purpose.fnb.variant: Stores F&B product variants such as Small/Medium/Large size or flavour/SKU variations.
purpose.fnb.price_list: Defines F&B prices for a currency, scope, channel and validity period.
purpose.fnb.price: Stores the selling price of an F&B product or variant within an F&B price list.
purpose.fnb.menu: Defines an F&B menu offered by a specific outlet.
purpose.fnb.menu_section: Groups menu items into sections such as Starters, Mains, Desserts or Drinks.
purpose.fnb.menu_item: Places an F&B-owned product/variant on a menu with kitchen/display settings.
purpose.fnb.modifier_group: Defines selectable modifier groups such as Size, Toppings, Sauce or Cooking Preference.
purpose.fnb.modifier_option: Defines an individual selectable option inside an F&B modifier group.
purpose.fnb.menu_item_modifier: Maps modifier groups that are available for a menu item.
purpose.fnb.recipe: Defines how an F&B menu item is prepared and how many portions the recipe produces.
purpose.fnb.recipe_item: Stores inventory ingredients and quantities required by an F&B recipe.
purpose.fnb.ingredient_substitute: Defines approved ingredient substitutions for F&B preparation.
purpose.fnb.dining_table: Stores restaurant dining tables, seating capacity, zone, and operational status.
purpose.fnb.table_reservation: Stores advance dining reservations for a guest or customer.
purpose.fnb.reservation_table: Maps one or more dining tables assigned to a reservation.
purpose.fnb.table_visit: Stores an active dining visit from seating until the table is closed.
purpose.fnb.kitchen_station: Defines a preparation station such as Grill, Fryer, Bar, Dessert, or Cold Kitchen.
purpose.fnb.kitchen_order: Stores a kitchen production ticket generated from an F&B order.
purpose.fnb.kitchen_order_item: Stores the individual preparation lines sent to kitchen stations.
purpose.fnb.sold_out_item: Records when a menu item is temporarily unavailable and when it becomes available again.
purpose.fnb.temperature_check: Stores HACCP-style temperature checks for food, storage, cooking, or equipment checkpoints.
purpose.fnb.food_safety_action: Stores actions taken to correct food-safety, temperature, or operational failures.
purpose.fnb.order: Stores the operational food-service order used by kitchen and serving workflows.
purpose.fnb.order_item: Stores each food or beverage item ordered, including course and kitchen notes.
purpose.fnb.product_recommendation: Defines product-level F&B upsell, cross-sell and sellable add-on recommendations. Example: Regular Coke to Large Coke (UPSELL), Burger to Fries (CROSS_SELL), or a sellable extra product (ADD_ON).
purpose.retail.product_category: Groups Retail products into business categories such as Apparel, Souvenir, Toy or Accessory.
purpose.retail.product: Stores the independent master record for each sellable Retail merchandise item. It does not depend on Ticketing Catalogue.
purpose.retail.variant: Stores sellable Retail SKUs such as Size/Colour combinations.
purpose.retail.price_list: Defines Retail prices for a currency, scope, channel and validity period.
purpose.retail.price: Stores the selling price of a Retail product or variant within a Retail price list.
purpose.retail.merchandise: Stores outlet/store-specific settings that link a Retail-owned product/variant to physical stock.
purpose.retail.return_policy: Defines Retail return eligibility and approval limits for an outlet or tenant scope.
purpose.retail.return: Stores the retail inspection and operational decision for merchandise being returned.
purpose.retail.return_item: Stores each returned merchandise item, its condition, disposition, and approved value.
purpose.retail.reservation: Stores merchandise reserved for later customer collection at a retail outlet.
purpose.retail.reservation_item: Stores each merchandise item and Inventory stock reservation included in a retail reservation.
purpose.retail.product_recommendation: Defines Retail upsell, cross-sell and add-on recommendations, including optional cross-service targets.
purpose.inventory.item: Stores inventory-controlled items such as ingredients, retail goods, packaging, and consumables.
purpose.inventory.location: Stores warehouses, storerooms, sections, bins, and outlet stock locations in a hierarchy.
purpose.inventory.stock_level: Stores the current quantity summary of an inventory item at a stock location.
purpose.inventory.stock_batch: Stores lot, batch, and expiry information for batch-tracked or perishable stock.
purpose.inventory.stock_movement: Stores every increase, decrease, reservation, release, transfer, adjustment, or wastage movement of stock.
purpose.inventory.stock_transfer: Stores movement of stock between inventory locations.
purpose.inventory.stock_transfer_line: Stores each inventory item and quantity included in a stock transfer.
purpose.inventory.stock_count: Stores an inventory count/stocktake performed at a warehouse or stock location.
purpose.inventory.stock_count_line: Stores the counted and theoretical quantity for each item in a stock count.
purpose.inventory.wastage: Stores stock loss such as expiry, spoilage, damage, preparation waste, or disposal.
purpose.inventory.supplier: Stores supplier/vendor master information used for inventory purchasing.
purpose.inventory.supplier_contract: Stores purchasing agreements, validity dates, and commercial terms agreed with a supplier.
purpose.inventory.requisition: Stores an internal request to purchase inventory items for a venue, department, or stock location.
purpose.inventory.requisition_line: Stores each inventory item and quantity requested in a purchase requisition.
purpose.inventory.purchase_order: Stores an approved purchase order issued to a supplier.
purpose.inventory.purchase_order_line: Stores each item, ordered quantity, price, and received quantity on a purchase order.
purpose.inventory.goods_receipt: Stores a receipt of goods delivered by a supplier against a purchase order.
purpose.inventory.goods_receipt_line: Stores received, rejected, batch, expiry, and cost information for each delivered item.
purpose.inventory.stock_reservation: Temporarily reserves stock for an order or operational requirement so it cannot be allocated elsewhere.
purpose.venue.venue: Stores the master record for each physical venue operated by a tenant.
purpose.venue.space: Stores physical spaces inside a venue such as screens, halls, arenas, rooms, or parking areas.
purpose.venue.department: Stores operational departments within a venue such as F&B, Box Office, Parking, Security, or Retail.
purpose.venue.zone: Stores named operational or navigational zones inside a venue or venue space.
purpose.venue.outlet: Stores physical selling or service outlets such as F&B counters, retail shops, box offices, or parking booths.
purpose.resources.resource: MODIFIED. Stores reservable operational resources such as rooms, equipment, lockers, or rental items, and now links a serialized resource to its Maintenance asset profile so exact rental equipment can be tracked through maintenance and lifecycle.
purpose.resources.resource_booking: Stores reservations of operational resources for a customer, staff member, or order.
purpose.maintenance.asset: MODIFIED. Stores operational equipment and physical assets that require status tracking or maintenance; the existing serialized equipment registry is reused for rental equipment.
purpose.maintenance.preventive_plan: Defines scheduled preventive maintenance for an asset.
purpose.maintenance.work_order: Stores corrective or preventive maintenance work assigned for an operational asset.
purpose.maintenance.incident: Stores operational, safety, or equipment incidents reported at a venue.
purpose.queue.queue: Defines an operational waiting queue for an attraction, service point, or experience.
purpose.queue.entry: Stores a customer or party currently waiting in an operational or virtual queue.
purpose.venuemap.layout: Stores an indoor or outdoor map definition for navigation within a venue.
purpose.venuemap.point: Stores navigable points or destinations on a venue map.
purpose.venuemap.route: Stores a navigable connection between two points on a venue map.
purpose.workforce.employee: Stores the main employee/staff master record.
purpose.workforce.job_title: Stores job/designation definitions such as Cashier, Manager, Chef or Technician.
purpose.workforce.work_assignment: Assigns an employee to a job and operational location/scope for an effective period.
purpose.workforce.employment: Stores employment terms and contract validity.
purpose.workforce.shift: Defines reusable shifts such as Morning, Evening or Night.
purpose.workforce.roster: Stores the employee roster/scheduled shift for a specific work date.
purpose.workforce.attendance: Stores summarized attendance for an employee and work date.
purpose.workforce.work_time: Stores individual clock-in/clock-out or attendance punch events.
purpose.workforce.leave_type: Defines leave categories and basic leave behavior.
purpose.workforce.leave_balance: Stores leave entitlement, used amount and remaining balance per employee/period.
purpose.workforce.leave_request: Stores employee leave requests and their approval state.
purpose.workforce.pay_component: Defines reusable earning and deduction components.
purpose.workforce.salary: Stores effective-dated salary configuration for an employee.
purpose.workforce.salary_component: Stores employee-specific salary earning/deduction component values.
purpose.workforce.payroll_run: Stores a payroll processing batch for a pay period.
purpose.workforce.payroll_employee: Stores calculated payroll totals for one employee in a payroll run.
purpose.workforce.payroll_line: Stores detailed earnings and deductions for an employee payroll calculation.
purpose.workforce.payslip: Stores the finalized payslip metadata for an employee/payroll result.
purpose.resources.rental_product_mapping: NEW TABLE. Maps a Catalogue rental product to the physical resource pool or quantity-based Inventory item used to fulfil it.
purpose.resources.rental_agreement: NEW TABLE. Stores the operational rental lifecycle for a customer after booking/order confirmation, including planned and actual handover/return times.
purpose.resources.rental_agreement_item: NEW TABLE. Stores each serialized or quantity-based item in a rental, enabling partial returns, missing equipment tracking, and per-item status.
purpose.resources.rental_inspection: NEW TABLE. Stores a before-rental or after-rental inspection performed against a rental agreement.
purpose.resources.rental_inspection_item: NEW TABLE. Stores structured condition results for each rented item or component during checkout/return inspection.
purpose.maintenance.rental_damage_assessment: NEW TABLE. Records rental-related damage, responsibility, charge recommendation, and maintenance follow-up for returned equipment.
purpose.orders.cart: Stores a temporary shopping cart before the customer completes checkout.
purpose.orders.cart_line: MODIFIED. Makes the cart support items recommended from Catalogue, FnB and Retail, and links add-on/recommended child lines to the main selected item.
purpose.orders.order: MODIFIED. Stores the permanent order created when a cart or direct sale is completed, and now also supports payment fees/surcharges and held orders completed through payment links.
purpose.orders.order_line: MODIFIED. Keeps the permanent parent/recommendation relationship so add-ons, cross-sells, upsells and upgraded lines can be audited after checkout.
purpose.orders.discount: Stores each discount or promotion actually applied to an order.
purpose.orders.payment_gateway: MODIFIED. Stores payment-provider configuration for Stripe, NI and future providers, including adapter, merchant connection, capabilities and connection health.
purpose.orders.payment_route: MODIFIED. Defines payment routing by payment-method master, channel, currency, priority and provider/fallback provider.
purpose.orders.payment: MODIFIED. Stores each payment attempt and its final transaction state for an order, and links it to the payment-method master, provider, terminal and payment link when applicable.
purpose.orders.refund: Stores full or partial refunds processed against a paid order.
purpose.orders.refund_policy: Defines refund limits and approval requirements for a tenant scope.
purpose.orders.pos_shift: Stores a cashier's POS work/till session for sales, refunds, and cash reconciliation.
purpose.orders.cash_movement: Stores manual cash movements made during a POS shift.
purpose.orders.cash_count: Stores a complete cash-count session for opening or closing reconciliation.
purpose.orders.cash_count_line: Stores the quantity counted for each cash denomination in a cash count.
purpose.orders.membership_renewal: Stores membership renewal transactions and the result of each renewal attempt.
purpose.orders.recommendation_activity: Tracks whether recommendations were shown, accepted, rejected, removed or purchased. This becomes the main source for upsell/cross-sell/add-on conversion reporting.
purpose.orders.upgrade: Stores the real post-purchase upgrade transaction, including original line, upgraded line and additional amount. Existing orders.payment should be reused to collect the upgrade amount.
purpose.orders.payment_method: NEW TABLE. Stores the master catalogue of payment methods supported by TICVAI.
purpose.orders.payment_policy: NEW TABLE. Stores a versioned payment policy that groups payment rules and can be submitted through the existing approval workflow before activation.
purpose.orders.payment_method_config: NEW TABLE. Configures where a payment method is enabled, including scope, channel and currency.
purpose.orders.currency_rule: NEW TABLE. Defines payment-level currency rules such as accepted/settlement currency, min/max payment amount and rounding.
purpose.orders.payment_eligibility_rule: NEW TABLE. Defines when a payment method is allowed or denied for a transaction.
purpose.orders.payment_fee_rule: NEW TABLE. Defines payment-related fees or surcharges that may be applied to an order.
purpose.orders.order_fee: NEW TABLE. Stores the actual fee/surcharge snapshot applied to a specific order.
purpose.orders.payment_link: NEW TABLE. Stores a provider-hosted payment link for an order that is on hold or pending payment.
purpose.orders.payment_terminal: NEW TABLE. Stores payment-specific configuration for a physical terminal while reusing the existing Platform device/workstation as the hardware master.
purpose.orders.deposit: NEW TABLE. Stores the financial/security deposit associated with a rental order, including hold, release, forfeiture, and settlement totals.
purpose.orders.deposit_activity: NEW TABLE. Provides an auditable history of every deposit authorization, hold, capture, release, forfeiture, refund, or adjustment.
purpose.access.access_point: Stores physical entry and exit points where tickets, passes, or parking rights are validated.
purpose.access.entry_rule: Defines when, where, and how an entitlement may be used for entry or re-entry.
purpose.access.entry_rule_point: Maps the access points that are allowed for an admission profile.
purpose.access.ticket_access: Stores the ticket, pass, membership access right, or other entitlement owned by a customer or subject.
purpose.access.scan: MODIFIED. Keeps the existing common scan history while allowing the same scanner/validation engine to record ticket, accreditation, membership and parking credentials.
purpose.access.blacklist: Stores media codes or entitlements that must be denied even if they would otherwise be valid.
purpose.access.parking_facility: Stores parking facilities that can issue and validate parking access rights.
purpose.access.parking_pass: Stores a customer's purchased or granted right to access a parking facility.
purpose.access.access_change: Audits ticket/access replacement during an upgrade. The old access should normally be marked UPGRADED/REPLACED and the new access becomes ACTIVE; old records should not be deleted.
purpose.access.accreditation_type: Defines reusable accreditation categories such as MEDIA, CONTRACTOR, VENDOR, EVENT_STAFF, SECURITY, VIP, ARTIST or SPONSOR.
purpose.access.accreditation: Stores the main accreditation record for one person, with event/venue context, approval state and validity period.
purpose.access.accreditation_document: Stores supporting document metadata/evidence submitted for an accreditation and tracks document verification.
purpose.access.accreditation_access: Defines where an approved accreditation is allowed to enter by mapping it to Access rules, access points and optional logical venue zones.
purpose.access.accreditation_credential: Stores the physical or digital credential issued for an accreditation, such as a badge, QR, barcode, RFID or NFC credential.
purpose.access.accreditation_status_history: Keeps an immutable audit trail whenever accreditation status changes, including approval, issue, suspension, revocation, expiry or cancellation.
purpose.ledger.company: Stores the legal company/entity for which financial books and accounting records are maintained.
purpose.ledger.account: Stores the company's Chart of Accounts such as Cash, Bank, Payment Receivable, Ticket Revenue, Tax Payable, and Wallet Liability.
purpose.ledger.journal: Stores one financial event header, for example an order payment, refund, wallet top-up, or settlement posting.
purpose.ledger.journal_item: Stores the Debit and Credit lines that make a journal entry balanced and identifies the ledger account affected.
purpose.ledger.settlement: Stores reconciliation summary between payment-provider settlement data and TICVAI's internal payment/ledger totals.
purpose.ledger.settlement_issue: Stores individual reconciliation problems such as missing payment, amount mismatch, duplicate provider line, or fee mismatch.
purpose.wallet.account: Stores the customer stored-value wallet master. It identifies whose wallet it is, wallet type, currency, and status.
purpose.wallet.balance: Stores the current wallet balance for fast checkout: available amount, held amount, and total amount.
purpose.wallet.transaction: Stores permanent history of every wallet balance movement such as top-up, debit, refund, adjustment, expiry, or reversal.
purpose.wallet.hold: Temporarily reserves wallet money while an order/payment is in progress so the same balance cannot be spent twice.
purpose.wallet.access: Controls which customer can view or spend from a wallet and what limits apply.
purpose.marketing.customer_segment: Defines a reusable customer audience segment for campaigns, loyalty, and targeted communication.
purpose.marketing.customer_segment_rule: Stores individual rules used to determine whether a customer belongs to a segment.
purpose.marketing.campaign: MODIFIED. Stores a marketing campaign; adds optional journey_id so the same campaign model can be reused by automated journeys.
purpose.marketing.campaign_target: Links a marketing campaign to the commercial item or offer it promotes.
purpose.marketing.consent_purpose: Defines why customer communication or marketing data may be processed and which channels it covers.
purpose.marketing.customer_consent: MODIFIED. Adds provenance fields so consent decisions can be traced to registration, waiver, campaign, survey or another business source.
purpose.marketing.do_not_contact: Stores contact addresses that must not receive messages through a specific marketing channel.
purpose.marketing.message_template: Stores reusable email, SMS, push, or in-app message content used by campaigns.
purpose.marketing.message_delivery: MODIFIED. Keeps outbound-delivery history but adds optional conversation and journey execution references for traceability.
purpose.marketing.campaign_response: OPTIONAL MODIFICATION. Add journey_enrollment_id only if reports need to attribute opens/clicks/conversions to a specific customer journey execution.
purpose.marketing.loyalty_program: Defines a loyalty programme through which customers earn points, tiers, and rewards.
purpose.marketing.loyalty_tier: Defines loyalty levels such as Silver, Gold, or Platinum and the threshold required to reach them.
purpose.marketing.loyalty_points: Stores every loyalty point earn, redeem, expire, adjustment, or reversal transaction for a customer.
purpose.marketing.points_earning_rule: Defines how customers earn loyalty points from purchases or other qualifying actions.
purpose.marketing.points_redemption_rule: Defines how loyalty points can be exchanged for discounts, products, or other benefits.
purpose.marketing.reward: Defines a loyalty reward that can be issued to eligible customers.
purpose.marketing.reward_assignment: MODIFIED. Reuses the existing reward engine for gamification and referral by recording which business feature generated the reward.
purpose.marketing.loyalty_campaign: Links a marketing campaign to temporary loyalty bonuses, rewards, or earning changes.
purpose.marketing.loyalty_rule: Defines temporary bonus points, multipliers, earning rules, or rewards applied by a loyalty campaign.
purpose.marketing.support_case: Stores a guest complaint, enquiry, service request or support issue from creation through assignment, escalation and resolution.
purpose.marketing.case_comment: Stores internal or guest-visible comments, updates and notes added to a support case.
purpose.marketing.sla_policy: Defines service-level response and resolution targets used by support cases.
purpose.marketing.journey: Defines a reusable automated customer journey, such as cart abandonment, post-visit follow-up or membership renewal reminder.
purpose.marketing.journey_step: Defines each ordered automation step in a customer journey, including waits, messages, conditions and actions.
purpose.marketing.journey_enrollment: Tracks each customer's live execution state inside an automated journey.
purpose.marketing.review: Stores guest star ratings and written reviews for catalogue, FnB, Retail, venue or service targets using logical cross-service references.
purpose.marketing.review_response: Stores staff or business replies to guest reviews and preserves moderation/reply history.
purpose.marketing.challenge: Defines a non-loyalty engagement challenge such as visit streaks, purchase goals, exploration tasks or seasonal missions.
purpose.marketing.badge: Defines a digital badge that can be awarded to a customer for challenge completion or other engagement achievement.
purpose.marketing.customer_badge: Stores badges actually awarded to customers and the source that generated each award.
purpose.marketing.customer_challenge_progress: Tracks the current measurable progress of each customer toward a challenge.
purpose.marketing.survey: Defines an NPS, CSAT, CES or general guest-feedback questionnaire.
purpose.marketing.survey_question: Defines each question, response type and display order within a survey.
purpose.marketing.survey_response: Stores one guest submission for a survey; individual answers may be retained in answers_json in the first version.
purpose.marketing.conversation: Stores one unified two-way customer-service or guest-conversation thread across WhatsApp, web chat, social or similar channels.
purpose.marketing.conversation_message: Stores each inbound or outbound message inside a two-way conversation thread.
purpose.marketing.waiver_template: Defines a versioned legal waiver/consent document that a guest must sign before a qualifying activity or service.
purpose.marketing.waiver_signature: Stores the auditable signature of a customer/guardian against an exact immutable waiver-template version.
purpose.marketing.privacy_incident: Logs privacy, personal-data or security incidents that require investigation, notification or regulatory follow-up.
purpose.marketing.data_subject_request: Tracks formal privacy/data-subject requests such as access, deletion, correction, export or restriction.
purpose.marketing.referral: Tracks customer-to-customer referrals from invite through qualification and any reward generated.
purpose.ai.provider: Stores AI provider and model configuration used for supported AI capabilities.
purpose.ai.usage_policy: Defines which AI capabilities are allowed for a tenant/scope and the main safety, masking, approval, and usage limits.
purpose.ai.conversation: Stores an AI chat/session container for a principal within a module and tenant scope.
purpose.ai.message: Stores each user, assistant, or system message within an AI conversation.
purpose.ai.activity: Stores usage, cost, outcome, and trace information for any AI request, including non-chat calls.
purpose.ai.knowledge_group: Defines a searchable knowledge base used by AI retrieval/RAG.
purpose.ai.knowledge_item: Stores document metadata for content indexed into an AI knowledge collection.
purpose.ai.indexing_job: Tracks asynchronous indexing or re-indexing jobs for AI knowledge content.
purpose.ai.action_request: Stores a business action proposed by AI and tracks whether it was approved, rejected, or executed.
purpose.ai.suggestion: Stores a non-binding AI recommendation or prediction for a business subject.
purpose.ai.suggestion_result: Stores whether a suggestion was accepted or rejected and the actual result used to evaluate AI quality.
purpose.reporting.report: Defines a reusable report, its data source, security requirement, date limits, and version.
purpose.reporting.report_column: Defines the columns, aggregation, sorting, and display format returned by a report.
purpose.reporting.report_filter: Defines fixed or parameter-driven filters applied when a report runs.
purpose.reporting.report_input: Defines runtime inputs such as date range, venue, channel, customer, or status for a report.
purpose.reporting.dashboard: Stores a reusable dashboard made from multiple reporting tiles.
purpose.reporting.dashboard_tile: Defines one report visualization displayed on a dashboard.
purpose.reporting.report_execution: Stores each report execution request, its parameters, result summary, performance, and status.
purpose.reporting.report_file: Tracks generated report files such as Excel, CSV, or PDF and their retention period.
purpose.reporting.report_schedule: Defines automatic recurring execution and delivery of a report.
purpose.reporting.schedule_recipient: Stores the people or destinations that receive scheduled report output.
purpose.reporting.alert_rule: Defines a threshold-based rule that raises an alert when a reporting metric crosses a configured limit.
purpose.reporting.alert: Stores each alert raised when a reporting metric breaches an alert rule.
purpose.sync.guest_link: Stores the pseudonymous link used to recognize the same guest across Cells without transferring the guest's full identity.
purpose.sync.cell_connection: Defines which source Cell is permitted to communicate with which target Cell.
purpose.sync.cross_cell_request: Stores each cross-Cell request such as validating membership, entitlement, benefit, or wallet eligibility.
purpose.sync.cross_cell_rejection: Stores cross-Cell requests that failed or were rejected, including the reason, retry information, and resolution.
purpose.control.channel: Defines sales and interaction channels such as POS, Kiosk, Web, Mobile App, and partner channels.
purpose.control.channel_item: Controls which Ticketing, FnB or Retail items can be sold through a particular sales channel and scope.
purpose.control.api_application: Registers an external or internal application that is allowed to call TICVAI APIs.
purpose.control.api_limit: Defines rate limits and usage limits for an API client.
purpose.control.webhook: Stores webhook endpoints that should receive selected TICVAI business events.
purpose.control.webhook_log: Tracks each webhook delivery attempt and its result.
purpose.whitelabel.brand_setting: Stores the current white-label branding and UI configuration for a tenant, venue, brand, or other scope.
purpose.whitelabel.brand_version: Stores a publishable version history of a white-label configuration so changes can be reviewed and rolled back.
purpose.whitelabel.custom_domain: Stores custom web domains used by a tenant or venue for a branded customer experience.
purpose.whitelabel.menu_item: Defines branded menu and navigation links shown in web/mobile experiences.
purpose.whitelabel.home_section: Defines configurable sections shown on the branded homepage.
purpose.whitelabel.banner: Stores branded promotional or informational banners displayed in the customer experience.
purpose.whitelabel.promotion_block: Stores branded promotional tiles that link UI content to an existing Catalogue promotion or destination.
purpose.whitelabel.page: Stores branded CMS-style pages such as About, Help, Terms landing pages, and venue information pages.
purpose.whitelabel.faq_category: Groups frequently asked questions into branded help categories.
purpose.whitelabel.faq: Stores individual frequently asked questions and answers.
purpose.whitelabel.policy: Stores branded legal/policy content such as Terms, Privacy Notice, Refund Policy text, and cookie information.
purpose.whitelabel.feature_setting: Controls customer-facing branded features for a tenant or venue without changing the underlying business data.
purpose.whitelabel.module_setting: Controls which licensed TICVAI modules are visible in the branded customer experience.
purpose.whitelabel.seo_setting: Stores search-engine and social-sharing metadata for branded pages, products, events, and other public entities.
purpose.whitelabel.redirect: Stores branded website redirects so old or changed URLs continue to work.
